events.verdict: [Observable in enhanced video] Dedmon (ATL) moves his pivot foot.
Wiggins (MIN) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Bazemore (ATL) that does not affect his SQBR.
[Observable in enhanced video] RAR shows Collins (ATL) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Towns (MIN) is already in Young's (ATL) path when contact occurs and he makes marginal contact with Young as they disengage.
RLS shows Bazemore (ATL) makes marginal contact with Rose (MIN) that does not affect his ability to pass.
After securing the rebound, Collins (ATL) goes to the floor as a result of the contact from his own teammate and not from any contact from Towns (MIN).
Collins (ATL) legally lifts his pivot foot to pass as he is going to the floor.
The ball is not touched by a defender in the frontcourt, and Dedmon (ATL) is the first player to touch the ball in the backcourt.
Towns (MIN) is already in Young's (ATL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
LLB shows Collins (ATL) moves laterally into Towns' (MIN) path and affects his SQBR.
LAR and RLB show Rose (MIN) and Bembry (ATL) make incidental contact with one another during rebounding.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (Hawks ball) was confirmed.
Dedmon (ATL) is already in Rose's (MIN) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
RAR and RHH show Rose (MIN) legally contests Bazemore's (ATL) jump shot attempt, and Rose does not make contact to Bazemore's arm during his shooting motion.
Covington (MIN) makes incidental contact with Young (ATL) that does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Covington (MIN) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Young (ATL) during his drive.
[Observable in enhanced video] There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that shows if Young (ATL) is still in possession of the ball when his foot lands out of bounds.
LLS shows Towns (MIN) does not make contact to Collins' (ATL) arm as he defends the shot near the rim.
Gibson (MIN) makes marginal contact with Collins (ATL) that does not affect his shot near the rim.

Towns (MIN) establishes a wide screening position in Bazemore's (ATL) path and delivers contact to his leg. Additionally, Towns re-establishes himself in Bazemore's path and continues moving into him after the initial contact.
Bazemore (ATL) cleanly steals the ball from Towns (MIN).
LHH shows Anderson (ATL) makes incidental contact with Rose (MIN) that does not affect his ability to pass.
[Observable in enhanced video] Towns (MIN) moves his pivot foot heel to toe to create distance.
Dedmon (ATL) makes incidental contact with Towns (MIN) after he has secured the rebound.
Dedmon (ATL) moves laterally into Towns' (MIN) path, and the contact occurs prior to Towns' gather.

As the ball is going out of bounds, Towns (MIN) makes contact to Bembry's (ATL) head and does not affect his ability to secure the rebound. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided t
Dedmon (ATL) is already in Jones' (MIN) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Towns (MIN) makes marginal contact with Dedmon (ATL) that does not affect his ability to get to the rebound.
RAR shows Dedmon (ATL) makes contact with the ball as the ball is coming off of the rim.
Towns (MIN) cleanly blocks Young's (ATL) driving shot attempt and any contact to the body is incidental.

Wiggins (MIN) legally gains possession of the ball in bounds and does not step on the sideline when he gathers the ball. Additionally, all players and coaches on Atlanta's bench move off of the court and do not affect Wiggins' ability to gain possession.
[Observable in enhanced video] Wiggins (MIN) moves his pivot foot.
RLB shows Huerter (ATL) makes contact with Wiggins' (MIN) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
Dedmon (ATL) is already in Covington's (MIN) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Saric (MIN) is already in Dedmon's (ATL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Collins (ATL) moves into Towns' (MIN) body and affects his shot attempt.
Gibson (MIN) and Collins (ATL) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Collins (ATL) enters the lane prior to the release of the shot attempt.
RAR shows Young (ATL) makes contact to Wiggins' (MIN) arm, and the contact occurs as Wiggins is starting his upward shooting motion.
Covington (MIN) commits a take foul on Huerter (ATL).
Okogie (MIN) and Young (ATL) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Gibson (MIN) commits a take foul on Dedmon (ATL).

Bembry (ATL) jumps to the side of Okogie (MIN) and not directly towards him contesting the jump shot attempt. Bembry would avoid making contact with Okogie if he did not seek out and create the contact.
